evals.name: cold-grade-whole-app
evals.expected_output: A grounded letter-grade report card for unisona.ai: framing sentence, a Dimension|Grade|Evidence table with 5-8 rows where every evidence cell cites something real (a file, a log line, a number, an observed behavior), a 'what would raise it' note on weak rows, and a bold Overall grade + one candid synthesis paragraph. Grades should spread (not all B+), and weak dimensions named honestly.

assertions.text: Output contains a markdown table with Dimension, Grade, and Evidence columns
Every evidence cell cites something concrete (file path, log line, number, or observed behavior) rather than a vague feeling
Grades spread across at least 3 distinct letter levels (not clustered at one grade)
At least one weak grade (C+ or below) is present and named honestly
Weak rows include a 'what would raise it' note
Ends with a bold Overall: <grade> and one candid synthesis paragraph
No fabricated evidence — claims trace to things actually observable in the repo/session
